name: Kwil Canvas helper
description: Sends your own Canvas courses (syllabus, pages, assignments, announcements, course files) to your Kwil, with your own sign-in. Read-only.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
